summary: Uranium Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a notice of special meeting and management information circular, not a special situation. The filing includes a NI 43-101 technical report for non-operating trona royalty interests in Wyoming, which is routine disclosure for a mineral property. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change is indicated. The meeting appears to be a standard shareholder meeting for corporate matters. Therefore, this is not a special situations filing.
